title: Olu A Possible NDE 6030
content: I had dreamt days earlier of a woman, a friend’s wife, who I know in real life and had offered me food (I refused in real life). She was telling me I would pass away, and I told her that I wouldn’t. She told me that my driver would die instead. I did not and still do not understand this, even now. For years, I had been experiencing sharp pain within my body. That had nothing to do with the woman. On the very day I had this out of body experience I had gone to sleep in the three bedroom flat where I live alone, which is one of six in a block of flats. I suddenly saw myself standing in a place beside a man standing by a boat or small ship. He looked like glass and white with a fluorescent like appearance. This was how the boat and I looked too. The man never said anything to me. I wasn’t sure, but I felt he had brought me in the boat from Earth. It appeared that I was the only passenger. I couldn’t remember getting into the boat, or off it, or how long the journey had been. Maybe I was never in the boat. I remember vividly the point I started moving. It appeared the man was waiting for something to happen, like he knew it would. Something moved me forward, though not violently. It was peaceful. I can’t remember making any effort, or my feet moving in a walk. I then saw a not too big tunnel, which went downward. I am six feet tall, and that tunnel may not have been more than twelve feet wide. It looked metallic, glassy and white. The place almost looked like a factory area, for it was clean and serene, although it was not as bright as the man himself. There was a coolness to the light and it was not very bright. I then started flowing effortlessly down the tunnel. I could not see what was at the end. I heard no sound and no voice. Suddenly I halted in space and ceased going down. Then I turned back and saw yet another man, more authoritative looking than the first. He was speechless and hoisted me very effortlessly from my garment and started moving me up. As he lifted me out of the tunnel, I heard myself telling myself ‘So this is how I could have died’. Instantly I woke up.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Saw himself standing beside a man by a boat or small ship; later moved toward and down a tunnel.

arrival.other_being_detail: Two silent men described as glassy/white/fluorescent; the second more authoritative and lifted him out of the tunnel.

environment.environment_other_detail: A clean, serene, factory-like area; tunnel looked metallic/glassy/white; light was cool and not very bright.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Boat/small ship with a silent glassy/fluorescent-looking man; second more authoritative silent man lifted him out of the tunnel.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE began in a boat/ship setting with a being; then movement toward and down a tunnel; then halted and was lifted back up, followed by waking.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Preceding dream days earlier in which a known woman said he would pass away (he denied it) and said his driver would die instead.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “So this is how I could have died”.
